For each green phase you are given: the number of waiting (queued) vehicles, the TOTAL accumulated waiting time of those vehicles in seconds, and whether it is the phase currently green. Choose the phase to serve next to MINIMISE total vehicle waiting time and unnecessary stops -- not simply the longest queue.

Reply with ONLY JSON {"phase": <index>} and nothing else. /no_think
